note: Full 17-criterion review of the exact final pack hash. criteria.prompt: Original/permitted source, author, distribution rights and no learner PII checked.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers checked the local source/provenance consistency. Pack and sources-batch-2 declare this an AI-assisted original, distribution authorized, with no copied exam/external text or learner data. This is a declaration, not independent proof of authorship or copyright; no PII is visible.

criteria.prompt: Phrase occurs in cited source and the contextual sense is supported.
criteria.evidence: The exact phrase make arrangements for appears in cited sentence s1: the department will make arrangements for students to attend a conference.

criteria.prompt: English gloss is the actual contextual meaning, not a selection rationale.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm to plan and organize something so it can happen matches organizing what is needed for conference attendance and is not too narrow.

criteria.prompt: Vietnamese gloss is accurate, natural and includes diacritics.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm sắp xếp, tổ chức cho việc gì is natural, accented Vietnamese and fits the contextual meaning.

criteria.prompt: Phrase occurs in cited source and the contextual sense is supported.
criteria.evidence: The exact phrase provide evidence of appears in cited sentence s2 about showing how the event relates to the applicant’s research.

criteria.prompt: English gloss is the actual contextual meaning, not a selection rationale.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm supplying proof or details that show truth/relevance fits the research-connection context.

criteria.prompt: Vietnamese gloss is accurate, natural and includes diacritics.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm cung cấp bằng chứng về việc gì is natural, accented Vietnamese and accurate.

criteria.prompt: Identify correct option and explain each distractor. No other plausible answer; no subjective style/intent assumptions.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers identify a as the only paraphrase of planning and organizing necessary details for attendance. b cancels attendance; c asks for speaker preferences without organizing attendance.

criteria.prompt: Every option explanation is accurate; grammar/collocation claims are not overgeneralized.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm a/b/c explanations match the corrected choices: organizing attendance, cancellation, and collecting speaker opinions. Earlier unsupported travel/registration/support wording was removed.

criteria.prompt: Identify correct option and explain each distractor. No other plausible answer; no subjective style/intent assumptions.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm a is natural (made arrangements for visitors to park); b has the wrong preposition of in this construction; c omits infinitival to. Only a is correct.

criteria.prompt: Every option explanation is accurate; grammar/collocation claims are not overgeneralized.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm the option notes identify the exact for/to-infinitive construction and the specific corrections without claiming all arrangements require an infinitive.

criteria.prompt: Identify correct option and explain each distractor. No other plausible answer; no subjective style/intent assumptions.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm a supplies proof/details of research relevance; b promises attendance and c pays a fee, neither of which provides such evidence.

criteria.prompt: Every option explanation is accurate; grammar/collocation claims are not overgeneralized.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm each explanation correctly distinguishes research-relevance evidence from attendance promises or fee payment.

criteria.prompt: Identify correct option and explain each distractor. No other plausible answer; no subjective style/intent assumptions.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm a alone is correct: improved safety is a noun phrase after of. b incorrectly puts a finite that-clause after of; c uses the bare verb improve where the noun-phrase complement is required.

criteria.prompt: Every option explanation is accurate; grammar/collocation claims are not overgeneralized.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm b’s specific correction (evidence that safety improved / evidence of improved safety) and c’s correction to improved safety. The earlier evidences distractor was removed after checking Oxford’s academic-English exception.

criteria.prompt: Role or purpose differs meaningfully from the source; not merely rewriting it.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm the transfer changes from departmental conference travel to a personal weekend trip with friends, with accommodation and transport planning.

criteria.prompt: Model answer is idiomatic and uses target; checklist is usable; writing is not automatically graded.
criteria.evidence: Both reviewers confirm the two-sentence sample naturally uses made arrangements for, covers accommodation and transport, and the checklist supports self-assessment without automatic grading.

findings.evidence: On the initial hash, q4 treated evidences as always wrong. Oxford notes evidences is sometimes used in academic English. Replaced it with an objectively invalid of + finite-clause construction and a bare-verb complement error; both final reviewers confirm the corrected q4 has one defensible answer.

On the initial hash, q1 added unsupported travel/registration/support details. Rewrote options and explanations to focus only on planning attendance, cancellation, and speaker preferences; both final reviewers confirm the revised wording.
